label: ElevenLabs

sound.note: Text to sound effect, up to 30 seconds per request; loops supported

voice.note: Text to speech in an account voice, with delivery markup in square brackets

balance.note: the plan's credits for this period: its allowance minus what the period has used

transports.note: Driven by jam audio; sign in with `elevenlabs auth login`

quote.how: jam audio sfx generate --dry-run and jam audio voice speak --dry-run print the list-price upper bound; the charge recorded afterwards is how far the account's usage figure moved

recovery: open the account's history in the provider's app and look for a generation with the same text at the time of the call
